.. change::
    :tags: usecase, configuration
    :tickets: 1891

    Enhanced configuration path handling so that relative
    ``version_locations`` entries are resolved relative to the directory of
    the configuration file that defines them, rather than the current
    working directory.  When both an ``alembic.ini`` and a
    ``pyproject.toml`` are supplied at once, each file may now contribute
    ``version_locations`` entries, with ``.ini`` entries listed first
    followed by the ``pyproject.toml`` entries; entries that resolve to the
    same path across the two files are de-duplicated.

    A new read-only :meth:`.Config.get_alembic_option_source` method and the
    new :class:`.OptionSource` constants allow the source of any Alembic
    option (``ini``, ``toml`` or an explicit override, such as one supplied
    from the command line) to be determined.
    :meth:`.Config.get_version_locations` now returns a list of
    :class:`.VersionLocation` objects, each carrying its fully resolved
    absolute path together with its source, and :class:`.ScriptDirectory`
    consumes these already-resolved entries directly so that resolution no
    longer depends on the working directory.

    Legacy path-list splitting (used when ``path_separator`` is not
    configured) is now also aware of native Windows drive letters, so a
    colon that introduces a drive (e.g. the ``:`` in ``C:\\foo``) is no
    longer mistaken for a list separator.
